title: Introduction to AI
overview: Artificial Intelligence is everywhere — from spam filters to voice assistants. Learn what AI is, how it relates to ML and Deep Learning, and where you'll encounter it daily.

data.body: AI is technology that learns from data to make decisions without being explicitly programmed for every situation.

AI studies thousands of examples.
It finds patterns without human rules.

It handles situations it has never seen before.
No manual updates required.
The more data AI receives, the better its decisions become.

From search engines to voice assistants.
AI works behind the scenes every day.

data.text:
AI doesn't follow fixed rules.
It learns patterns from data.

data.label: AI vs ML vs DL — SVG placeholder

data.text: AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning

data.body: AI is the broadest field — any technique that makes machines appear intelligent.
ML is a subset of AI — algorithms that learn patterns from data instead of hard-coded rules.
DL is a subset of ML — multi-layered neural networks that excel at vision, speech, and language.

Any technique that makes a machine appear smart — search, rules, logic, or learning.
The broadest umbrella. A chess engine is AI just as much as ChatGPT.

AI that learns from examples instead of rules you wrote.
More data → smarter model. No manual rule updates needed.

ML powered by many-layered neural networks.
Unlocked images, speech, and language — things older ML couldn't handle.

Every AI today does exactly ONE thing.
Face ID can't chat. ChatGPT can't drive. General AI doesn't exist yet.

data.text: DL ⊂ ML ⊂ AI — each is a subset of the one above. Knowing where a system sits tells you exactly how it works.

blocks.title: AI, ML, and DL Are Like Russian Dolls
blocks.subtitle: They're not separate boxes side by side. Open AI — ML is hidden inside. Open ML — DL is inside.

panels.label: The Outer Doll: AI
panels.description: AI is the largest shell: everything that makes machines appear smart — search, logic, expert systems, and learning all under one lid.

panels.label: Inside AI: ML Emerges
panels.description: Crack open the AI shell and Machine Learning lifts out. Instead of hand-written rules, ML learns its own patterns from data — fitting entirely inside AI but doing something far more powerful.

panels.label: Inside ML: Deep Learning
panels.description: Open ML and there's Deep Learning at the core: multi-layered neural networks that unlocked images, speech, and language. The smallest doll — but the one that changed everything.

blocks.insight: All Deep Learning is ML.|All ML is AI.|But not all AI is ML — and|not all ML is Deep Learning.
blocks.reinforcement: When someone says 'AI', they often mean Deep Learning.|Now you know the precise difference between all three.

data.body: Before you even arrive at school, you have already used five different AI systems.
Your phone unlocked, your route planned, your inbox filtered, your feed ranked, and your assistant understood you — all powered by AI.
Your phone does not compare a stored photo. A neural network studied thousands of images of your face at different angles and learned its unique geometry. It recognises you — not a picture of you.
Maps evaluates millions of possible routes every time you navigate. Search explores the options; Optimisation picks the fastest one based on distance, live traffic, and historical patterns.

Your inbox was protected by a model trained on millions of labelled emails. It found patterns — certain words, sender behaviour, formatting — without being told a single rule. It adapts as spammers evolve.

Netflix compares your watch history with millions of other users. People who watched what you watched tend to enjoy certain other shows. This collaborative filtering predicts your taste with surprising accuracy.
ChatGPT learned from billions of sentences. It does not look up answers — it generates them word by word, predicting the most likely continuation based on everything it learned about human language.

data.text: Every technique you'll study in this course — search, probability, ML, neural networks, language — is already powering the apps on your phone right now.

blocks.title: AI is Like an Orchestra
blocks.subtitle: A musician plays many instruments but leads to one symphony. We use AI for many different tasks, all with one final goal: making life easier.

panels.label: Real World
panels.description: An orchestra has many instruments — violin, trumpet, drums, flute, piano.|Different sounds, one piece of music.

panels.label: Each Speaks Differently
panels.description: Each instrument has its own voice and role.|An orchestra needs all of them, not just one.

panels.label: The Conductor Unites
panels.description: Without a conductor, the orchestra is just noise.|With one, every musician follows the same beat.

panels.label: AI is the Same
panels.description: Face Unlock, Maps, Spam Filter, Netflix, ChatGPT —|different techniques, same goal: make life easier.

panels.label: One Symphony
panels.description: Every AI technique — from search to language models —|plays the same symphony:|making life simpler.

blocks.insight: Every AI service plays a different instrument.|You don't see the orchestra — you just hear the music.
blocks.reinforcement: Your phone unlocks, your route plans, your spam filters —|all playing together before you even arrive.|That's the symphony. You're living in it.
